claim: semantic-benchmark/1.3.0 qualifies P06 candidate behaviour on the support statuses SUFFICIENT, PARTIAL and INSUFFICIENT.
limitations: semantic-benchmark/1.3.0 does NOT qualify P06 UNCERTAIN behaviour.
P06 model-selection claims are limited to SUFFICIENT / PARTIAL / INSUFFICIENT.
UNCERTAIN remains an explicit residual risk.
This limitation blocks any later claim that Phase 9 alone established full P06 contract coverage.
production_contract_note: UNCERTAIN remains a first-class member of the P06 support-status contract. v1.3 changes no production prompt, DTO, materializer or planner semantics. What v1.3 declares is the limit of its own qualification evidence.

uncertain_coverage_gate.rationale: No candidate-scoring P06 property asserts UNCERTAIN as the correct support status, so a qualification run cannot observe whether a candidate reaches UNCERTAIN when the deciding artifact is absent. The instrument must not manufacture that coverage.
